# OV MJ Calculator - Comprehensive Project Analysis

## 1. Project Introduction

### Purpose Statement
The OV MJ Calculator is a specialized web-based Mahjong scoring calculator designed for Taiwanese-style Mahjong (台灣麻將). This application provides an interactive interface for players to input their hand configurations and calculate scores based on various winning conditions and special rules specific to Taiwanese Mahjong.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Interactive Hand Management**: Allow users to drag-and-drop tiles into hand, exposed, and winning tile areas
- **Comprehensive Scoring**: Calculate points based on complex Taiwanese Mahjong rules including special conditions like Tenhou, Chihou, and various bonus scenarios
- **Mobile-Friendly Interface**: Provide touch support for mobile devices with responsive design
- **Real-time Calculation**: Update scores instantly as users modify their hand configuration

### Target Audience
- Taiwanese Mahjong players seeking accurate score calculation
- Mahjong enthusiasts learning the game's scoring system
- Players who want to verify their understanding of complex winning conditions

## 2. Technical Architecture

The project follows a simple yet effective client-side architecture:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[mj.html - UI Layer] --> B[mj.js - Application Logic]
    A --> C[mj.css - Styling]
    B --> D[mjConst.js - Data Constants]
    B --> E[checkHandType.js - Scoring Logic]
    
    F[User Input] --> A
    A --> G[Drag & Drop System]
    G --> B
    B --> H[State Management]
    H --> I[Score Calculation]
    I --> J[UI Updates]
```

### Component Breakdown
- **UI Layer** (`mj.html`): HTML structure with sections for tile selection, hand management, settings, and results display
- **Application Logic** (`mj.js`): Core business logic handling state management, user interactions, and scoring calculations
- **Data Layer** (`mjConst.js`): Static data definitions for all Mahjong tiles and their properties
- **Styling** (`mj.css`): Responsive CSS with mobile-first design principles
- **Scoring Engine** (`checkHandType.js`): Specialized logic for Taiwanese Mahjong scoring rules

### Design Patterns
- **State Management Pattern**: Centralized application state in a single `state` object
- **Event-Driven Architecture**: Extensive use of event listeners for user interactions
- **Component-Based UI**: Modular sections with clear separation of concerns
- **Drag-and-Drop API**: Native HTML5 drag and drop with custom touch support

## 3. Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points
- **HTML Structure** (`mj.html`): Defines the complete user interface with sections for tile selection, hand management, exposed tiles, winning tile selection, settings, special conditions, and results display
- **Application Bootstrap** (`mj.js`): Initializes the application, sets up event listeners, and manages the main application lifecycle

### Core Modules
- **Tile Management** (`mj.js`): Handles tile selection, dragging, dropping, and state updates
- **Scoring Engine** (`mj.js` + `checkHandType.js`): Implements complex Taiwanese Mahjong scoring rules
- **State Management** (`mj.js`): Centralized state handling for all game variables and user selections

### Configuration Approach
- **Static Configuration** (`mjConst.js`): Defines all tile types, values, and display information
- **CSS Variables**: Uses consistent color schemes and styling patterns throughout the application
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with breakpoints for different screen sizes

### External Dependencies
- **No Framework Dependencies**: Pure vanilla JavaScript implementation
- **Native APIs**: Utilizes HTML5 Drag and Drop API, Touch Events, and DOM manipulation
- **Browser Compatibility**: Supports both desktop and mobile browsers with fallbacks

### Integration Points
- **Drag and Drop System**: Custom implementation supporting both mouse and touch interactions
- **Event System**: Comprehensive event handling for all user interactions
- **State Synchronization**: Real-time updates between UI components and application state

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[User Interaction] --> B{Interaction Type}
    B -->|Tile Selection| C[Update State]
    B -->|Settings Change| D[Recalculate Score]
    B -->|Action Button| E[Validate & Execute]
    
    C --> F[Render UI Updates]
    D --> F
    E --> F
    
    F --> G[Display Results]
```

## 4. Key Features

### Functionality Overview
- **Interactive Tile Selection**: Click or drag tiles from four categories (萬子, 索子, 筒子, 字牌) into hand area
- **Hand Management**: Organize tiles into hand, exposed (吃/碰/槓), and winning tile sections
- **Special Conditions**: Configure complex winning scenarios including Tenhou, Chihou, Ippatsu, and various bonus conditions
- **Real-time Scoring**: Instant score calculation with detailed breakdown of point sources
- **Mobile Support**: Full touch interaction support for smartphones and tablets

### Implementation Highlights
- **Advanced Drag & Drop** (`mj.js`): Custom implementation with touch support, visual feedback, and error handling
- **Complex State Management** (`mj.js`): Comprehensive state tracking for all game variables and user selections
- **Responsive UI** (`mj.css`): Mobile-first design with adaptive layouts and touch-optimized controls
- **Modular Architecture** (`mjConst.js`): Clean separation of data definitions from business logic

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> SelectingTiles: Add Tiles
    SelectingTiles --> ConfiguringHand: Arrange Hand
    ConfiguringHand --> SettingConditions: Set Rules
    SettingConditions --> Calculating: Submit
    Calculating --> DisplayResults: Show Score
    DisplayResults --> Idle: Reset
    
    SelectingTiles --> ConfiguringHand: Complete Hand
    ConfiguringHand --> SettingConditions: Ready to Score
```

## 5. Conclusion and Recommendations

### Project Architecture Summary
The OV MJ Calculator demonstrates a well-structured, single-page web application that effectively implements complex Mahjong scoring logic through clean separation of concerns. The architecture successfully balances simplicity with functionality, making it accessible while providing comprehensive features for Taiwanese Mahjong scoring.

### Key Characteristics
- **Client-Side Only**: No server dependencies, runs entirely in the browser
- **Mobile-First Design**: Optimized for touch interactions and responsive layouts
- **Extensible Architecture**: Modular design allows for easy addition of new scoring rules
- **User-Friendly Interface**: Intuitive drag-and-drop interface with clear visual feedback

### Architectural Strengths
- **Clean Separation**: Clear distinction between UI, logic, and data layers
- **Robust Error Handling**: Comprehensive validation and user feedback
- **Performance Optimization**: Efficient state management and DOM updates
- **Accessibility**: Good keyboard navigation and screen reader support

### Potential Improvement Areas
- **Code Organization**: Consider modularizing the large `mj.js` file into separate modules
- **Testing Coverage**: Add unit tests for scoring algorithms and edge cases
- **Configuration Management**: Extract hardcoded values to external configuration files
- **Documentation**: Add inline code comments and API documentation

### Recommendations for Enhancement
1. **Modular Refactoring**: Split the monolithic `mj.js` into smaller, focused modules
2. **State Persistence**: Implement localStorage for saving user preferences and recent hands
3. **Export Functionality**: Add ability to export hand configurations and scores
4. **Multi-language Support**: Extend internationalization for broader accessibility
5. **Performance Monitoring**: Add analytics to track usage patterns and optimize performance

### Next Steps for Project Evolution
- **Feature Expansion**: Add support for additional Mahjong variants and scoring systems
- **Community Features**: Enable sharing and comparing hand configurations
- **Educational Mode**: Include tutorials and rule explanations for learning purposes
- **API Development**: Create REST API endpoints for integration with other applications
